atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4 — defines a custom variant selector. Usage: @variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4 — defines theme tokens as CSS custom properties.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4 — explicitly adds a source path for class scanning.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4 — registers a custom utility class.

properties.name: text-wrap
properties.description: Shorthand for text-wrap-mode and text-wrap-style. Controls how text inside an element wraps.

values.name: wrap
values.description: Text wraps at appropriate soft-wrap opportunities (browser default).

values.name: nowrap
values.description: Text does not wrap; overflowing content is clipped or scrollable.

values.name: balance
values.description: Text is wrapped in a way that balances the number of characters on each line for improved layout quality.

values.name: pretty
values.description: Wraps text with aesthetics in mind (e.g. avoiding orphans), at a performance cost.

values.name: stable
values.description: Wraps text with performance in mind; lines before the caret are not reflowed while editing.
